maya: Quick sync 19:00-21:00 PT publish window tonight. Targets: Py 1.5.0 (deprecate redwood-sync later) and TS 2.0.0 (async-only).
maya: Canary plan: dark-launch 3% -> canary 10% -> ramp 30% -> GA. We will gate TS rename behind FEATURE_ASYNC_V2 flag so we can flip back quickly.
trent: Ack. I'll run deploy-bot and hold the TS flag toggle until we confirm shim compatibility. Need exact publish commands + dist-tag plan.
lucy: Commands:
```
Py: python -m build && twine upload dist/*  # publishes 1.5.0
TS: cd packages/sdk && npm publish --access public && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 experimental
```
lucy: Dist-tag policy: 'experimental' for dark-launch/canary, 'latest' after GA. Deprecation: we'll add warnings for redwood-sync in Py 1.5.0 runtime logs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job 1753210000-darklaunch, targets: py:1.5.0@3%, ts:2.0.0@3%. ETA +4m.
maya: Ops please pin a Dedicated fallback and prepare quick unpin script. Also assign release-notes owner.
ops: Done. Pinned redwood@1.4.13 into fallback pool (TTL 24h). API call: curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/pins -d '{"package":"redwood","version":"1.4.13","pool":"fallback","ttl":"24h"}'
ops: Added playbook: ops/release/quick-revert.sh to reassign dist-tags and flip FEATURE_ASYNC_V2=false. Alerts wired: token-error >2% or p50 +40ms.
trent: Deploy-bot confirmed dark-launch start: deploy-bot: Dark-launch started (1753210000-darklaunch-py) at 3% traffic. Monitoring window 20m.
lucy: Staging found a shim mismatch for TS when FLAG was true. Error: `TypeError: shim.request is not a function` in dist/shim.js. Patch in PR but needs a quick fix.
trent: Hold TS ramp. Initiating rollback for TS experimental tag only.
trent: deploy-bot, revert dist-tag 1753210000-darklaunch-ts -> set experimental to 1.9.6 and unpublish 2.0.0 from experimental.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job queued for 1753210000-darklaunch-ts. Reassigning experimental -> 1.9.6. Status: in-progress.
maya: OK TS paused. Proceeding with Py dark-launch at 3% while ops keeps fallback pinned. Docs: can you draft release notes and call out delayed TS + migration snippet?
docs: On it. I'll add a migration example showing openSession() -> connect() rename and a code snippet for migrating. Draft PR link when ready.
maya: Rollback triggers recap: sustained token error rate >2% (baseline <0.5%), any production canary smoke fail (auth/connect/streaming), artifact checksum mismatch, or auth regressions >1% of tokens. If triggered run quick-revert.sh, ping #eng-oncall and #devex.
ops: Playbook includes curl commands and npm dist-tag steps. Also added a manual Slack action button in deploy-bot to run quick-revert.sh if paging.
trent: Monitoring will watch 20m; if green we go to 10% after 30m. Action owners: trent (deploy), lucy (ts fix), ops (pin/playbook), docs (notes).
maya: Proceeding with Py dark-launch. Will paste final deploy-bot confirmation when it starts.
